hub.speaker: A Villager
hub.text: They look at you like the words are arriving from somewhere else, half a second late. "Fine. I'm fine. Everyone keeps asking that."

text_variants.text: So that's what that was. I keep losing the thread of what I meant to say to you. Thank you. However it happened, thank you.

remember.speaker: A Villager
remember.text: Pieces. A price I agreed to without reading the whole of it. A voice that wasn't mine coming out of my own mouth for weeks. I keep waiting to feel angrier about that than grateful. Maybe both fit.

options.text: For what it's worth, I'm glad it's over.
